projects.name: SentinelLink
projects.problem: During emergency spikes, dozens of citizens report the exact same incident. Without automated filtering, responders face severe notification fatigue and socket networks saturate with broadcast noise.

highlights.text: Full-stack PERN platform for incident reporting with real-time geolocation pinning and media uploads.
Stateless backend with JWT authentication and role-based access control (citizen, responder, dispatcher).
Room-based Socket.IO broadcasting that cuts unnecessary network fanout by 100% across unaffected sectors.
Duplicate detection using geospatial and time thresholds (200m / 10min) to automatically merge redundant reports.
Live incident visualization with Leaflet heatmaps and sub-50ms event dispatch.

projects.name: EduArchive
projects.tagline: Academic resource platform for IIIT Bhubaneswar students
projects.problem: Course syllabi, previous-year question papers (PYQs), and laboratory manuals were scattered across informal chats and drives, causing 10+ minutes of friction per search.

highlights.text: REST API with role-based access control for students, contributors, and verified department admins.
Normalized PostgreSQL relational schema indexed by Branch (CSE/ETC/EEE/IT), Academic Year, and Semester.
Reduced resource-search time by ~60% in internal student benchmark testing.
Direct Cloudinary streaming pipeline with in-browser PDF preview supporting large academic files without download lag.
Debounced multi-field search engine with an admin-moderated contribution verification queue.
